_comment: Internal team notes, not report text. Bullet facts only. {{json:file#a.b}} reads a value from a repo file, {{csvrows:file}} counts rows, {{f:fact_id}} reads the fact registry built by build.py. Failure and lesson wording is copied from PROCESS-LOG.md (entry numbers in brackets); rewrite it here if the log changes.

sessions.title: first recordings and cleaning
added: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#barometer_magnetometer_stops}} stationary recordings (barometer + magnetometer) and {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#accelerometer_segments}} walking recordings (accelerometer); stops on iPhone17,4, walks on iPhone19,2 [1]
one Wi-Fi log: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#wifi.wifi_rows_clean}} clean Wi-Fi rows [1]

{{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#sensor_rows_clean}} clean sensor readings of {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#sensor_rows_source}} source readings, {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-14/summary.json#sensor_rows_excluded}} quarantined [1]
failures: location labels unreliable: every old name untrusted [1]
26 stop files vs 25 numbered location descriptions, cause never found; BM04 unmatched [1]
labelling workflow (assignments, submissions) set up but no submissions came back through it [2]
lessons: from 17 Nov the file names carry the route, which is what later made relabelling possible [2]

sessions.title: trial session, 30 s stops
added: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-17/summary.json#barometer_magnetometer_stops}} stops (30 s) and {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-17/summary.json#accelerometer_movements}} walks, floors 5 and 4; stops iPhone17,4, walks iPhone19,2, Wi-Fi on a Samsung SM-A556E [4]
{{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-17/summary.json#wifi.wifi_rows_clean}} Wi-Fi rows [4]
Dicta's positioning pilot on this data: {{f:pilot.knn}} kNN on 2 s slices, train and test slices from the same recordings [5]
failures: pilot accuracy was leakage (neighbouring 2 s slices of one visit are near copies); marked superseded and moved to phase2/old [5, 17]
Wi-Fi: only part of the stops have rows (Android scan throttling); 12 stops with none [4]
one stop exported twice: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-17/summary.json#exclusion_reason_counts.duplicate_reexport_interval_superseded_by_BM19}} duplicate rows quarantined [4]
labels only route-inferred: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-17/summary.json#stop_label_confidence_counts.route_confirmed_both_sides}} of 26 confirmed on both sides [4]
lessons: next session used longer stops (about 60 s) and added the gyroscope [4]
a different day is needed as test set; same-recording splits are only an upper bound [5]

sessions.title: two-floor session, 60 s stops, gyroscope
added: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#stops_unique}} stops ({{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#floor_counts.5}} on floor 5, {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#floor_counts.4}} on floor 4) and {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#movements}} walks [7]

{{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#sensor_rows_clean}} accepted readings of {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#sensor_rows_source}}; {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#wifi.logs}} Wi-Fi logs [7]

relabelled from the collector's route on 24 Nov: {{csvcount:phase2/new/cross-day/out/label_changes_vs_provisional.csv|labels_agree|False}} of {{csvrows:phase2/new/cross-day/out/label_changes_vs_provisional.csv}} labels changed, none of the floors [9]
steps counted on all walks: {{f:pdr.23Nov.steps}} [19]
failures: pause/resume produced duplicate recordings: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-23/summary.json#duplicate_reexport_intervals}} duplicate intervals quarantined [7]
labelling rule 'stop = origin of next walk' mislabelled stops with no walk after them [7, 9]
no accelerometer logged at stops, so stops cannot be tilt-corrected [13]
stop phone and walk phone are different iPhones; mean |B| per place correlates only {{f:tilt.device_corr}} [14]
fixed barometer threshold failed (weather drift): {{f:d3.floor.iphone_test_23nov.abs}} on 23 Nov in the day-3 rerun; step tracking {{f:d3.floor.iphone_test_23nov.step}} [11]
WiGLE Wi-Fi near useless: logs an access point only when new or stronger [12]
lessons: revisit test (same day, later visit): {{f:cd.revisit_23.magnitude_xyz_knn_baro_floor}}; cross-day 23 to 17 Nov: {{f:cd.cross_core.magnitude_xyz_knn_baro_floor}} (|B|+xyz with floor) [10]
start a NEW recording at each stop (no pause/resume); log accelerometer + gyroscope at stops; one phone for the whole protocol [13, 14]
tilt correction on 23-Nov walk endpoints: {{f:tilt.lopo.tilt-corrected (low-pass gravity)}} vs {{f:tilt.lopo.raw x/y/z}} raw x/y/z, same day only [15]

sessions.title: two sessions (sesi 1: four phones, sesi 2: two phones)
added: sesi 1: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi1/clean/summary.json#recordings_unique}} unique recordings ({{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi1/clean/summary.json#stops}} stops + {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi1/clean/summary.json#walks}} walks), phones {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi1/clean/summary.json#phones}} [23]

sesi 2: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi2/clean/summary.json#recordings_unique}} recordings ({{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi2/clean/summary.json#stops}} stops + {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi2/clean/summary.json#walks}} walks), phones {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-24/sesi2/clean/summary.json#phones}} [23]
first independent second pass: train one session, test the other (no same-day leakage) [23, 30]
accelerometer logged at stops, so tilt features are possible at stops [30]
same-handset cross-day (ip16, 23 Nov to 24 s2): {{f:d3.xday_23nov_to_24s2_iphone.|B|+xyz + baro floor}}, reverse {{f:d3.xday_24s2_to_23nov_iphone.|B|+xyz + baro floor}} [30]

weighted fused kNN, honest: {{f:fused.take.leave_one_session_out.fused}} leave one session out, {{f:fused.take.grouped_by_stop.fused}} by stop; leaky random windows {{f:fused.take.random_LEAKY.fused}} [32]
failures: the 'iphone' slot was two different handsets (iPhone19,2 in s1, iPhone17,4 in s2) [30, 37]
S24 barometer unusable for floors: largest same-floor consecutive change {{f:d3.floorstats.24s1_s24.jump}} in s1 [23, 30]
floor step tracking broke after a long break in s1: {{f:d3.floor.iphone_test_24s1.step}}; largest same-floor change {{f:d3.floorstats.24s1_iphone.jump}} [30]
Wi-Fi still not a fingerprint: each BSSID about once per stop ({{f:wifi.rows_per_bssid.24s2}} rows per BSSID in s2) [31]
pooling all phones in one kNN worse than per-phone model [32]
very strong field (above 100 uT) at the 4F escalators in s2 on both phones, cause unknown [34]
lessons: most of the |B| spread is handset and day, not place: place share of |B| variance {{f:var.session_first.B.place}}, phones {{f:var.session_first.B.phone}}, sessions {{f:var.session_first.B.session}} [38]
phone held the same way (flat, facing the door) makes raw x/y/z work; tilt adds nothing on top [24, 30]
20 s pieces triple n but not the information; removing pieces raised accuracy by removing hard test pieces: LOSO {{f:fused.split20.leave_one_session_out.fused}} on pieces [40]

sessions.title: complete route on both floors (Dicta: ip18, a55, a56) plus spot recordings at hard places (our partial WhatsApp export)
added: complete set (Dicta, 2026-11-25/): {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/summary.json#recordings_unique}} unique recordings, {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/summary.json#stops}} stops ({{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/summary.json#stops_floor5}} on 5F, {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/summary.json#stops_floor4}} on 4F) and {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25/clean/summary.json#walks}} walks [28]

our partial export (2026-11-25-spots/): {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#recordings_found}} recordings found, {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#recordings_labelled}} labelled (per track and device: {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#per_track_device}}); {{csvcount:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/duplicates_vs_2026-11-25.csv|status|byte_identical}} of its files byte-identical to Dicta's and left out, the spot takes of ip16 and s24 kept as session 25spots [42, 49]
spot recordings aimed at the places never classified correctly before (list fixed beforehand in entry 41) [41]

{{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#recordings_unlabelled|len}} recordings of our export unlabelled (WhatsApp stripped 11 S24 names; recovered 26 Nov from the user's own file names, high confidence) [42]

Wi-Fi from one scanner only (S24, spots track): {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#wifi.stops_with_wifi}} of {{json:phase2/clean-data/2026-11-25-spots/clean/summary.json#wifi.stops_total}} stops have Wi-Fi [42]; Dicta's Wi-Fi log was scanned on a56, which the fused kNN does not use (s24 scanner only) [49]
